ApiKeyCreateResponse.description:
One-time create result. Both plaintext aliases are retained for exact
compatibility with the existing generated contract.

ApiKeySummaryResponse.description:
Admin-visible API-key metadata. Secret hashes are never part of this wire
contract.

updated_at.description: Newsly-owned pointer timestamp, always serialized in UTC when present.

fetched_at.description: Newsly-owned fetch timestamp, serialized as an RFC 3339 UTC value.

stats.description: Platform-specific metrics are intentionally heterogeneous at this boundary.

ContentSubmissionResponse.description: Result of creating or reusing one submitted URL.

platform.description: Normalized platform for an existing record; new submissions return null until analysis.

already_exists.description: Whether the URL matched an existing Content row.

task_id.description: Reused or newly queued analysis task identifier, when analysis is needed.

created_at.description: Provider-owned timestamp. Kept as text because upstream formats are heterogeneous.

generated_at.description: Newsly-owned generation timestamp. Unlike provider comment dates, this is guaranteed UTC.

ErrorEnvelope.description: Stable error representation at every Newsly HTTP boundary.

JobStatusResponse.description:
Public status projection for one durable processing task.

This deliberately exposes only the stable job contract. Internal queue
payloads and failure diagnostics are not part of the polling boundary.

NewsItemDetailResponse.description:
Canonical short-form News detail data.

The constant compatibility fields keep already-installed Content-detail decoders working while
the response omits Content-only processing, artwork, feed, and long-form summary state.

NewsItemListResponse.description:
Paginated canonical News feed.

The wrapper key names intentionally remain compatible with installed clients. The item type is
News-owned, and `content_types` truthfully contains only `news`.

NewsItemSummaryResponse.description:
Canonical short-form News card data.

`content_type` and `is_saved_to_knowledge` remain on the wire while installed clients still
decode this endpoint through their legacy Content card adapter. They have one truthful value
for this News-owned response and are not used as a cross-product identity fallback.

discovery_run_id.description:
Server-owned discovery run whose persisted proposals are being confirmed. This is `null`
only for the explicit non-personalized path, which cannot select discovered suggestions.

id.description:
Present for suggestions persisted under a discovery run. Synchronous preview suggestions
are not selectable completion resources and therefore carry `null`.

SubmissionResult.description:
Canonical typed outcome for one submitted item.

The legacy top-level submission fields remain temporarily on
[`SubmissionStatusResponse`] for installed clients. New clients use this union so feed-only,
Learning Deck, and no-action data cannot appear on unrelated result kinds.

oneOf.description: Installed-client compatibility field. New clients use `result`.
Installed-client compatibility field. New clients use `result`.

rationale.description: Installed-client compatibility field. New clients use `result`.

oneOf.description: Installed-client compatibility field. New clients use `result`.
Installed-client compatibility field. New clients use `result`.

SubmitContentRequest.description: Request to submit a user-provided URL for processing.

oneOf.description: Optional content-type hint. New records are still persisted as unknown until analysis.

title.description: Optional title supplied by the client or share sheet.

platform.description: Optional platform hint, such as `spotify` or `substack`.

instruction.description: Optional analysis instruction. `note` remains accepted as the legacy input alias.

crawl_links.description: Whether analysis should create content items for relevant discovered links.

subscribe_to_feed.description: Whether to detect and subscribe to a feed instead of saving the URL as inbox content.

share_and_chat.description: Whether to mark the content read and start a dig-deeper chat when it is ready.

chat_initial_message.description: Optional first user message for the share-and-chat session.

save_to_knowledge_and_mark_read.description: Whether to mark the content read and save it to the user's Knowledge library.
